actual_scope: Prove the P112 rank-six span-five bound after two six-flat covers and one common fourteen-line deletion set, then apply it to TWOSIDE profile 2,3,4,6^8.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first override of the generic formal-interface card. PR3185 supplied the quotient-basis cover but left this exact common-cut implication open. This is a written and finite computational proof, not a Lean formalization.
bottleneck_link: Closes one stated implication for a still-open historical P112 decoder-floor profile. It does not improve the selected supplier or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at a literal common-cut counterexample, the complete scoped span theorem or the session cap. Do not extrapolate to full C5 or a decoder floor.

open_questions.question: Which other actual remaining TWOSIDE beta profiles admit the same two-six-flat/common-fourteen-line quotient basis and require at least six nonbasis rank-six directions?

open_questions.blocked_by: An up-to-date overlap-aware residue list and an explicit caller binding; weight-only resemblance is insufficient.
